title: Introduce frugal regimen defaults catalog and dry-run econ simulator
author: Maya Chen
description: Context and motivation: We need a first-class, opinionated set of 'frugal regimen' defaults that are safe for managed tenants to adopt out-of-the-box and a simulator that can estimate unit-econ impact before rollout. This PR introduces: 1) a defaults catalog (catalog/v1) that encodes batching, prefill/cache hysteresis, and quantization profile suggestions as named presets; 2) a CLI dry-run simulator (cmd/econ-dryrun) that replays representative tenant request traces against a chosen preset to produce P50/P95 latency, token-cost, and estimated per-request unit econ; 3) telemetry hooks and tracing tags so the console can visualize simulated vs actual outcomes; 4) migration and schema validation tooling to safely add presets in future. Design notes: - Presets are deliberately conservative: safe fall-through to baseline model and non-destructive cache settings. - Simulator runs in a sandbox mode (does not change production routing or caches) and supports multiple replay modes (sampled, continuous, synthetic). - Quantization profiles are annotations (not enforced) that map workload shape heuristics to candidate qconfigs; actual enforcement is left to separate rollout ops. Checklist: - [x] Defaults catalog schema and validator - pkg/econ/catalog.go, internal/config/catalog_schema.yaml - [x] CLI dry-run simulator and replay engine - cmd/econ-dryrun/main.go, internal/sim/replay.go - [x] Telemetry events and console knobs - observability/metrics/econ_sim_metrics.go - [x] Unit tests and integration smoke - tests/econ_sim/* - [x] Docs: console guide and how-to (docs/ops/frugal-regimen.md) Example usage: econ-dryrun --preset frugal-small --trace-id tenant-123 --mode sampled --lookback 7d -> writes a simulation.json with latency/p99, token-cost, and a suggested rollout risk score Migration: new presets added to configs/catalog/frugal-presets.yaml. The catalog loader validates schema on startup and will emit a non-fatal warning if unknown fields are present. Rollout plan: - Stage 1 (canary): enable simulator for SRE/product to validate top-10 tenants (manual) - Stage 2 (opt-in): expose preset list in Console under "Cost Optimization" with an opt-in dry-run button - Stage 3 (suggestions): surface top-2 recommended presets in the Cost Advisor UI after 2 successful dry-runs Backwards compatibility: presets are additive and the loader respects older schemas. No runtime behavior change unless operators explicitly promote a preset to tenant config. Security notes: simulator runs with read-only access to trace/archive storage and does not provision GPU; quant annotations do not change model binaries. Performance: simulator is CPU-bound and can run in the control plane; we've added rate-limits and queuing for multi-tenant runs. Known limitations and follow-ups: - Integration with the rollout engine (A/B canary) will be a follow-up (ENG-8830) - Add cost sensitivity estimation per token-type (short vs long) - Provide a webhook-based callback for downstream CI to gate config promotion Commit summary: 6 commits - Add catalog schema and loader (initial) - Implement frugal-presets YAML and default entries - Add econ-dryrun CLI and replay engine - Integrate telemetry and metrics for simulation runs - Tests + docs - Fix config edge case: allow legacy sample_rate key Files changed (high level): - pkg/econ/catalog.go: new loader, validator - configs/catalog/frugal-presets.yaml: initial presets (small, medium, burst-safe) - cmd/econ-dryrun/*: CLI entrypoint, replay engine, output formatter - internal/sim/replay.go: core replay and cost estimator - observability/metrics/econ_sim_metrics.go: simulation duration, error counts, sample histograms - docs/ops/frugal-regimen.md: operator guide - tests/econ_sim/*: unit and integration cases Testing notes: - Local unit tests: go test ./pkg/econ - Simulated replay runs produced expected p95 delta <= 5% vs baseline simulator harness - E2E on staging: ran dry-run on two tenants and compared predicted vs measured (within expected tolerance) Release notes: Adds a new defaults catalog for cost-conscious tenants and a CLI simulator to estimate economic impact. No automatic changes to tenant configs; opt-in only. Risk and mitigations: the preset validator is conservative and will not accept any preset that disables cache entirely; CLI defaults to a read-only sandbox. This PR intentionally focuses on introducing safe primitives and UI-facing telemetry hooks rather than automatic enforcement or rollout. For reviewers: pay attention to catalog schema changes and the simulator's sampling logic (internal/sim/replay.go).

review_comments: Jordan Blake: Nice shaped PR. One question: the sampling mode defaults to 'sampled' — can we add a deterministic seed flag for reproducible runs?
Maya Chen (author): Good call. Added --seed to CLI and documented behavior. Seed is optional and only used for sampled mode.
Sofia Martinez: The catalog validator is strict; I saw one preset fail because of a missing required 'safe_fallback' key. We should make the error message actionable.
Maya Chen (author): Updated validator to include file/line context in error, and added a unit test for that case.
Ethan Ross: CI initially failed on linters (unused var) and GH actions timeout for the new workflow. After fixes, CI passes. Approving.
Sofia Martinez: Approve after addressing validator message and adding a small doc blurb about rollout stages.
release_notes: Added frugal defaults catalog and a dry-run econ simulator CLI. Operators can preview unit-econ impact of presets before promoting them. Opt-in; no automatic tenant changes.
notes_for_ops: To run the simulator in staging: make econ-dryrun && ./bin/econ-dryrun --preset frugal-small --trace-id <tenant> --lookback 72h --out simulation.json. Simulator requires read-only access to archived traces and will emit metrics under observability.econ.simulation.*
